## Summary

Describe the user-facing behavior and why it is useful.

## Safety impact

Explain allowlist, permission, confirmation, redaction, and destructive-action implications. Write `None` only when the change cannot affect them.

## Verification

- [ ] `pnpm check`
- [ ] New or changed behavior has targeted tests
- [ ] Public tool counts and documentation are current
- [ ] No credentials, private IDs, local paths, or sensitive logs are included
